entries.proposition: DESIGN: one patient, 20 months, compound heterozygous HMGCS2 variants confirmed in both parents; urine organic acids by GC/MS and acylcarnitines on a dried blood spot.
entries.snippet: Molecular genetic analysis of the HMGCS2 gene in leukocyte DNA from the patient, identified compound heterozygosity for a missense mutation c.634G>A

entries.proposition: GLYCAEMIA: the initial glucose was 4.6 mmol/L (3.3 to 5.6) before dextrose, after two days of vomiting and limited oral intake; glucose and serum ketone bodies are reported normal, with severe high anion gap acidosis.
entries.snippet: Initial investigations indicated normoglycemia (blood glucose 4.6 mmol/L, reference range 3.3‐5.6)

entries.proposition: The authors state the mechanism by which hypoglycaemia was averted is unclear; no counter-regulatory hormone or fuel measurement is reported anywhere in the article.
entries.snippet: The mechanism by which hypoglycemia was averted remains unclear.

entries.proposition: CONFOUNDERS: the child was febrile with EBV, adenovirus and rhinovirus positivity, took colloidal silver and herbal preparations, and later developed features suggestive of haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis; stress-hormone surge from this illness is a candidate explanation for normoglycaemia, unmeasured.
entries.snippet: our case had a persistent high grade fever and was positive for EBV, adenovirus and rhinovirus

entries.proposition: The only other normoglycaemic case with an acute-phase glucose was sampled after intravenous fluids, so the claim of a third case rests on one clean pre-dextrose value (this one) and one reported without hypoglycaemia (a Japanese case).
entries.snippet: The only other case 4 in which normoglycemia occurred in the acute phase was investigated following the administration of intravenous fluids.

entries.proposition: Ketone paradox: marked ketonuria in a disorder of ketone synthesis; the authors suggest leucine-derived HMG-CoA and hypothesise, without testing, that the ketonuria may have been cerebroprotective.
entries.snippet: We hypothesize that the extent of ketonuria in this case may have been cerebroprotective.

entries.proposition: Dextrose 10 percent was started after the first sample and the infusion maximised (glucose infusion rate 8.7 mg/kg/min); recovery of acidosis at 13 hours and a normal neurological examination on day 4 are reported, so the outcome is confounded by the treatment given.
entries.snippet: dextrose concentration maximized (glucose infusion rate 8.7 mg/kg/min)

entries.proposition: Figure 1 (presentation): the chromatogram carries large 3-hydroxybutyrate and acetoacetate peaks, large glutarate, adipate and 3-hydroxyisovalerate, and small labelled peaks A to E for the putative biomarkers; peak D (4HMP) is barely above baseline.
